note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The two witnesses agree on the substantive text.

adjudicated.ruling: Both witnesses print a bare initial: the typical edition drops the acute on a CAPITAL, which is typography and not a claim about the word. The same leaf sets éxcita lowercase and accented in the Advent III gradual and Excita capitalized and bare in the Advent III alleluia. The accent is restored here, as it is on every other capitalised word in this edition (checks/capitals.py).
The typical edition's punctuation is retained. The difference marks phrasing and does not change the words.
